meta.name: business-growth-skills
meta.description: Router/index for the 4 business & growth skills bundled in this plugin: customer-success-manager (health scoring, churn risk, expansion), sales-engineer (RFP analysis, competitive matrices, PoC planning), revenue-operations (pipeline, forecast accuracy, GTM efficiency), and contract-and-proposal-writer. Use when a growth/revenue request doesn't obviously match one skill and you need to pick the right one (e.g., 'which accounts are at risk', 'should we bid on this RFP').

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据增长需求自动分配合适的业务技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要处理客户健康度、RFP分析或收入预测等增长任务
copy.tagline_en: Route growth requests to the right business skill automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often handle tasks like health scoring, RFP analysis, or pipeline forecasting

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会根据你的请求自动判断属于客户成功、销售工程、营收运营还是合同撰写，然后加载对应技能来执行任务。
howto.when: 当你提出与业务增长或营收相关的问题，且不明确属于某个单一技能时触发，例如询问“哪些客户有流失风险”或“我们该不该投标这个RFP”。

say.text: 帮我分析哪些客户有流失风险。

say.note: Claude 会加载销售工程技能，分析RFP并给出竞争定位。

say.text: 检查一下销售管道覆盖率和预测准确度。
say.note: Claude 会加载营收运营技能，计算管道覆盖率和MAPE。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically routes your request to the appropriate skill (customer success, sales engineering, revenue operations, or contract writing) based on the content, then executes that skill's workflow.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask a business growth or revenue-related question that doesn't clearly match one skill, e.g., 'which accounts are at risk' or 'should we bid on this RFP'.

say_en.text: Analyze which accounts are at risk of churn.
say_en.note: Claude loads the customer success skill to compute health scores and churn risk.

say_en.text: Should we bid on this RFP?
Check pipeline coverage and forecast accuracy.
say_en.note: Claude loads the revenue operations skill to compute pipeline coverage and MAPE.
